validation.note: The held-out scores are the values that run reported, to five decimal places; the exact floats live in its elo_fit.json artifact. Five places is what the page shows and far more than the publish gate needs, which only asks that the Brier beat a coin flip. measured_on_elo_sha256 is sha256 of the canonical "elo" block above, so changing a parameter without re-fitting fails the build instead of publishing this claim over it.
